newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Welspun Stahl Rohren Ltd opens Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Welspun Stahl Rohren Ltd opens Jan 28.

text.p: The following initial public issue (IPO) by India's Welspun Stahl Rohren Ltd opens today for public subscription:
Face value Rs 10 per share value
Post Issue Holding of Promoters 48.00 percent.

Promoted by Welspun group of companies, Welspun Stahl Rohren Ltd (WSRL) is implementing a project to produce large diameter spiral pipes upto 25,000 tpa and longitudinal Submerged Arc Welded pipes upto 175,000 tpa. Involving an outlay of 1,920 million rupees, the project is being financed by a mix of debt and equity. The equity portion of 1,000 million rupees is to be brought in together by the promoters (480 million rupees) and a public issue, while the debt component is 920 million rupees. The project is being set up at Bharuch, Gujarat and is scheduled to be completed by May 1997. The technical collaboration for the project is being provided by Intertec Internationale GMBH which is also contributing an amount of 90 million rupees towards the equity of the company. The company has an export obligation under EPCG scheme to export. To comply with the same, the company plans to export 25 percent of its produce to countries like Brazil, South Africa and West Asia.
The project success hinges on the company's ability to get American Petroleum Institute's accreditation, mandatory for securing government orders.
